prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for [choose_path, redesign], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] as each category has only one test.
[finish, redesign] changes can be helpful, as two tests won (+5.5% and +4.3% after noise correction), while three showed no clear effect.
Evidence for [adoption, new_flow] and [adoption, new_screen] remains mixed: for each category, one test won while the remaining tests showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Evidence for [adoption, redesign] remains inconsistent across four tests: one won (+5.5% after noise correction), two were worse or stopped early (-8.4% and -4.0%), and one showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too low for all winning tests.
Predictions were usually too high for tests that stopped early, lost, or showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: -1.0% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +3.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +1.2% after noise correction, 5 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 83.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 28.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Account Verification Tip Toast: Display an informative tip banner detailing how account authentication preserves custom pet data across re-launches. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing back in, while sign_in loses 27.1% of onboarding users.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Adoption Certificate Celebration Flow: Insert an interactive pet spirit preview screen prior to finalizing adoption so users can test voice and animation responses. (why: Adoption stage experiences high abandonment (26% drop-off); giving active feedback before final confirmation boosts user investment.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Preflight Render Wait Info: Add an active time estimate and display overlay permission hints on the waiting screen while the pet engine initializes. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop.)
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Diagnostics Screen: Add a pre-launch diagnostic checklist screen to verify desktop overlay access and rendering status before spawning the pet. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets not appearing on screen or the app stalling at startup.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sync Reorder: Move sign-in to take place immediately after adoption certificate confirmation rather than before pet selection. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users when presented upfront; deferring authentication until after users select a pet increases completion.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion First Interactive Quest Flow: Add an end-of-onboarding micro-quest screen guiding users to drag their desktop pet once to unlock onboarding completion. (why: Finish improvements consistently win in testing, and 3 users wrote support expressing confusion over basic pet interactions.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Mode Interactive Trait Hint: Add explicit contextual hints on the path choice screen clarifying how companion energy and interruption levels differ per mode. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating uncertainty when selecting a mode.)

scores.note: High drop-off step with 8 support complaints; notification toast is cheap and low-risk.
Target step has high abandonment, but new flows in adoption historically yield mixed results.
Directly addresses 2336s mean wait time and complaints via simple UI overlay feedback.
Requires adding a whole new screen for a small set of support issues at home step.
Sign-in reordering showed strong negative impact (-8.3%) in historical test data.
Finish stage flows showed strong positive historical lift (+10.0%), though cost is higher.
Contextual hints clarify path choice without new screen cost, reducing 514s mean duration.
